assumptions.money: All resource prices and route CAPEX are independent test assumptions in the inherited PIK numerical EUR convention; no currency conversion or common price year is claimed.
assumptions.temporal: Hold NBS2020 provincial production constant as 2030 local product demand; no final-demand or trade inference.
assumptions.baseline: Estimate 2020 route output shares from GEM2026 capacity; estimate gross baseline electricity and direct CO2 using the same simplified route coefficients. Neither quantity is an observation.
assumptions.sector: Transfer Henan2024 sector shares to every province; unobserved other-ferrous residual remains in other-industry.
assumptions.flexibility: Minimum load, ramps, capacity additions, resource bounds, scrap fraction and inventory costs are explicitly selected test conditions, not empirical estimates.
assumptions.fuels: Simplified fuel combustion accounting; BF byproduct recovery is not explicit. EAF/DRI minor electrode and fuel inputs are omitted, so their zero direct CO2 is a simplification, not a claim of zero plant emissions.

routes.name: BF-BOF
routes.notes: Gross electricity 0.21343 minus rolling 0.04049 MWh/t from one historical plant, transferred as an estimate; BF coal 4.30*1.03 and CO2=coal*0.0036*96; ore from MPP candidate. Still includes casting; the study functional tonne differs from crude tonnes (1.04266 t crude per functional t), deliberately retained as an approximation. Mixed-source simplified engineering boundary.

routes.name: scrap-EAF
routes.notes: REMIND simplified EAF electricity and scrap coefficients; casting/rolling excluded; minor direct fossil/electrode emissions omitted for validation only.

routes.name: H2-DRI-EAF
routes.notes: EAF plus 1.065 tDRI/tsteel; direct power=.67+.08*1.065, H2 LHV=2.23*1.065, pellet=1.44*1.065. Generic ore supply is treated as pellet equivalent; pelletization costs/energy not explicitly modeled.

portability: The annual electricity HDF is an external PIK resource, not redistributed here. Supply --load with an equivalent complete 2030 hourly provincial HDF and regenerate this bundle; compare its SHA256 to reproduce this exact fixture.
